risks.evidence: City service calls layers official/current while layer text says planning reference and not property-rights evidence.
risks.mitigation: Treat as mapped observation; require Title 24/adopted-plan corroboration and City confirmation for verified/current labeling.

risks.evidence: 1,511 La Mesa-attributed parcel points fall in three adopted plan polygons; base zoning alone may be incomplete.
risks.mitigation: Version each adopted plan and suppress conclusions until the applicable plan is bound.

risks.evidence: Local code and guidance can lag California ADU law.
risks.mitigation: Reconcile every ADU rule to effective state statute and HCD guidance.

risks.evidence: AB 956 was chaptered September 29, 2026 and changes the future profile.
risks.mitigation: Keep CA_ADU_2026 through 2026-12-31 and a separately sealed CA_ADU_2027 effective 2027-01-01.

risks.evidence: No multi-code representative-point or APN grouping was observed, but point joins cannot prove full-parcel absence.
risks.mitigation: Packet 64 must intersect full county parcel polygons with dissolved base-zone geometry and quantify coverage.

risks.evidence: Hillside, scenic, floodway, design, mixed use, Grossmont and tract overlays may modify rules.
risks.mitigation: Classify every overlay as context or rule-modifying before rule selection.

risks.evidence: 17,422 City zoning features collapse to 14,175 APNs because condo/common geometry repeats; 14 features lack APNs.
risks.mitigation: Never replace County identity; join spatially and dedupe geometry.

risks.evidence: GeoJSON exports contain 2 invalid zoning, 1 invalid overlay, 5 invalid land-use and 2 invalid specific-plan geometries.
risks.mitigation: Apply pinned make-valid policy and prove area/count invariance before load.

risks.evidence: 663 County LM parcels lack address; city casing/format differs.
risks.mitigation: APN is primary identity; address remains search alias with jurisdiction disambiguation.

risks.evidence: MaintStar and monthly project lists do not establish a complete parcel-addressable export.
risks.mitigation: Keep permit activity phase two and unknown when no deterministic linkage exists.

risks.evidence: Downtown and Grossmont updates are publicly described as draft/in progress.
risks.mitigation: Bind only adopted documents; store proposals separately and exclude from current conclusions.

risks.evidence: Guidebook/quick sheet predates current 2026 state materials.
risks.mitigation: Historical/supporting only; never current-law authority by itself.
